notes.md: - **Crewed Moon landing:** India aims to land an **Indian on the Moon by 2040**, with the **Bharatiya Antariksh Station by 2035**.
- **Green propellant on POEM-3:** **RUDRA 0.3 HPGP**, a **green monopropellant** thruster of start-up **Bellatrix Aerospace** (Bengaluru), flew on **POEM-3** of **PSLV-C58** (**1 Jan 2024**).

new.s:
